# One repository, so that the sweep's command line is exercised on EVERY event
# rather than only at 06:17.
#
# ⛔ It names THIS repository on purpose. The full list must not run on a pull
# request -- an advisory in landingkit would redden a pull request that has
# nothing to do with it -- but a command line nobody has seen work is the same
# defect this workflow exists to fix. So every event runs the identical binary,
# the identical flags and the identical -list mechanism over a repository whose
# state the gate job in the same workflow is already about. A red here is about
# this repository, which is legitimate on a pull request to it.
#
# ⛔ Keep it to one line. This is a smoke test of the invocation, not a second,
# smaller policy about what gets watched.
go-fleettools/fleettools
